name: Lemborexant
description: A dual orexin receptor antagonist approved for insomnia, with faster receptor dissociation than suvorexant.

systems.note: Orexin receptor blockade; the labelled mechanism.
CYP3A-metabolised; contraindicated in severe hepatic impairment.

monitors.why: Labelled contraindication in severe hepatic impairment.
Labelled next-day somnolence and worsening depression.
